summary_en: This phase 1 study tests TR-002, a drug given into a vein, in people with advanced or metastatic solid tumors and in people with treatment-refractory pancreatic adenocarcinoma. TR-002 is given as an intravenous infusion over 1 hour on days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of each 28-day cycle, and cycles repeat if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The study measures safety, side effects and the best dose of TR-002.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa TR-002, un medicamento que se administra en una vena, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos y en personas con adenocarcinoma de páncreas refractario al tratamiento. TR-002 se administra como infusión intravenosa durante 1 hora los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y los ciclos se repiten si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la dosis óptima de TR-002.
who_for: Aged 18 or older at the time of consent.
Metastatic or unresectable solid tumor for which standard treatments no longer work or are not tolerated.
Expansion cohort: metastatic or unresectable pancreatic adenocarcinoma refractory or intolerant to standard treatments.
Heart function with left ventricular ejection fraction above 50%, and ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Blood counts, liver and kidney function within the limits stated in the record.
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding, or of reproductive potential and not using effective contraception.
Heart attack or unstable angina within 6 months, or stroke or TIA within 6 months.
NYHA Class II or greater heart failure, certain heart rhythm problems, or QTc above 470 msec.
Active bacterial, fungal, or viral infection.
Known hypersensitivity to 4-aminoquinolone compounds, retinal or visual field changes, psoriasis, porphyria, G6PD deficiency, or seizure disorder.
